简介: Malcolm Kelner is an actor, writer, and comedian. Born and raised in Minnesota, he graduated from Emerson College in Boston. He is best known for playing Jennifer Lopez's friend The Realist in This Is Me... Now: A Love Story (2024), as well as roles in NBC's Extended Family (2023) and Hulu's Welcome to Chippendales (2022). He is also known for his unique brand of satire online, where he has 250k combined followers.
